//identity: `slug` is the URL segment and the data directory name. It must never change
once published — every owner, player and matchup URL sits underneath it.
`features` gates whole subsystems: a league without keepers should not
generate keeper routes, capture ADP, or show the Keepers tab at all.
name: Den Ops Super League
//discovery: Sleeper creates a NEW league_id every season and links it backward via
`previous_league_id`. There is no forward pointer, so the sync script finds
next year's league by listing `anchorUserId`'s leagues for that season and
picking the one whose previous_league_id matches the latest known season.
That also disambiguates from other leagues the anchor user plays in.
//cloudinary: Photos and videos of the last-place punishment. Same cloud as every other
league here; what separates them is the TAG (<slug>-<season>), which is how
the site finds anything. The FOLDER is invisible to the site and exists only
so the Cloudinary console is navigable.
ONE PRESET FOR EVERY LEAGUE. Which folder an upload lands in is sent per
request as asset_folder=<slug>/punishments, which only works while the
preset leaves its own Asset folder BLANK — a value set there overrides the
request, silently and with a 200. Verified: one preset, both leagues, each
//owners: EVERY PERSON IS A FIRST-CLASS OWNER, including co-owners. A co-owned team's
record is credited to every owner on it, so Maddy is credited for Jake's
seasons and Katie for Jaymie's. Consequence: summing all-time wins across
owners double-counts co-owned seasons. That is intended — these are personal
records, not a league ledger — and the UI says so.
A team-season still has ONE primary owner (`teamSlug`), used to group keeper
contracts and to key franchise URLs. For Sleeper seasons that is the roster's
`owner_id`; for imported ESPN seasons it is the first owner ESPN lists.
`slug` is the stable URL key and must never change once published.
`active: false` marks someone who has left; they still appear throughout
history but never on the keeper board or current-season views.
`espnNames` maps the display names ESPN used to this owner.
